notes:
Cale AI Workbench 0.24.72 for Windows

- Music performances default to one camera for the whole song. Request cutaways or a montage when you want to change angles.
- Realistic performances carry nine full-resolution frames and the matching audio into each new render block. The original camera reference holds the framing while the performer moves.
- Fixed periodic soft frames during decoding. The decoder keeps the full motion context for each block and uses spatial tiles to fit the image in GPU memory.
- Realistic performances use the recorded soundtrack and a second detail pass. Phone videos render at 864 × 1536 and 24 frames per second.
- Offline setup verifies and reuses matching local model files. The eight additional model files total 54.3 GB on a fresh PC.

Development commits are 9b3161163b6f7d91b569d2fc330fb7a5a9fbb9f7 and 9de8a5afc3493dd2de4652e2a4b92cf805be0d51.
